column2: After managing to $$脱獄$$ from $$ゴルゴダ$$ Prison and becoming wanted, the party...
headed for the $$太陽の神殿$$ in the city of $$リベイラ$$, led by $$ヨハネ$$.
They trusted $$ヨハネ$$'s word that they might learn their $$ご主人様$$'s whereabouts.
But $$ヨハネ$$ had a plan from the beginning.
A vast plan—driven by deeply personal ambition...
one that was entirely his own...
